hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on, and code behind it divides by zero on the account page. Error rate jumped from ~1% to 20-36% in the exact minute the flag began evaluating 'on' (21:42), with every error becoming ZeroDivisionError.
supporting_evidence: 2026-09-02T21:42:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero

hypotheses.summary: Alternative: a code change/deploy carrying the faulty division logic was already live and only became reachable when the flag flipped; no deploy appears in the change record for the 18:00-21:47 window, so this is unsupported unless an earlier deploy is found.
supporting_evidence: Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-02T18:00:00Z to 2026-09-02T21:47:28Z. [ only the flag-toggle entry ]
2026-09-02T21:42:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero

hypotheses.summary: Note on the stated onset (20:19): the metrics from 20:19 to 21:41 are indistinguishable from baseline jitter (0-3.5%) and the logs there show only sporadic UpstreamTimeout on payment authorization. That background timeout noise is a separate, pre-existing condition and did not cause the alert.
